sentences.text: 1 .  Heard Mr. S. Das, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. B. Sharma, learned Addl.
P.P, Assam and Mr. T.A. Laskar, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2.
2.

The petitioners, namely, [1] Billal Hussain and [2] Robial Hoque have filed an application under Section 439 Cr.PC with prayer for bail as they are in custody since 04.10.2023 in connection with Manikpur P.S. Case No. 186/2023 under Section 376 IPC read with Sections 9/10/11(1) of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 read with Section 6/17 of POCSO Act.
3. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
4. It is submitted at the Bar that the petitioners are booked under the offence of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.
The victim is the petitioner No. 2's wife and she has attained majority.
It is also submitted that as the petitioner No. 2 is the victim's husband, no offence under the POCSO Act is made out.
There is no allegation of sexual assault.
5. Considering all aspects, petition is allowed.

The petitioners are enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-
each with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge,
Bongaigaon.
